name: Finder navigates to the Desktop and comes back
about: A second real desktop, so the scaffold is not proved only against the Apple menu. It navigates with a keyboard shortcut, asserts the window title changed to the folder asked for, goes back, and asserts the screen returned block for block. The sheet-based route (Cmd+Shift+G) is deliberately not used: a Go-to-Folder sheet that an earlier run left open swallows synthetic keys, and a scenario that depends on it fails for a reason that has nothing to do with the product.

steps.note: keystrokes follow the frontmost app, not the app whose tree you just read
the window title is the folder name, so this is the navigation itself, not a redraw
back where it started, block for block
